Expand cube lock/upload coverage to all four pools, making the wrong upload API mutation observable again. Keep independent indexed-draw physical-vertex enumeration with stream0 bound, plus explicit missing-stream0 no-op checks.

The three cross-API XP harnesses await renderer cleanup even when an assertion fails. No production guest or host source changes beyond the accepted4L14 batch. Publish the exact Metal-accepted retail8/9/DDraw DLLs; retain same-source4L14 diagnostic8/9 builds.
